title: performance canary: automated regression detection and rollout guards
author: Lucas Chen
description: Adds an adaptive performance canary detector and rollout guard framework to detect sustained latency/throughput regressions during rollouts and automatically pause or rollback traffic. Motivation: reduce manual intervention and shorten time-to-detect for regression windows that are not captured by single-point checks. This PR implements: 1) a detector that continually evaluates p50/p95/p99 latency and throughput deltas against historical baselines with configurable sensitivity and hysteresis; 2) KV-aware heuristics so small model-cache-driven cold-starts do not trigger false positives; 3) rollout guard rules that can abort, pause, or throttle traffic when the detector observes sustained regressions across multiple windows; 4) a canary scoring metric and dashboard hooks for visibility; 5) a perf test harness and synthetic workloads used in CI to reduce flakiness. Checklist: Implement detector algorithm and config schema. Add rollout guard state machine and API hooks. Wire observability (metrics + tracing). Add unit + integration perf tests and update docs/runbook. Update helm chart values for canary ops. Tests: local microbench + CI perf suite. Backwards compatibility: default sensitivity is conservative to avoid accidental rollbacks. See linked linear tickets for tuning strategy and rollout plan.
